audit_title: NairaLLM Pretraining Lock Audit Failure Diagnosis & Repair

root_cause_analysis.audit_crash_root_cause:
1. Hardcoded Windows path `WORKSPACE_ROOT = Path(r'c:\Users\user\Desktop\naira os')` in final_pretraining_lock_audit_v2.py failed when executed on Linux / Google Colab (/content/naira os).
2. When Pillar 2 failed due to missing path, generate_markdown_report() attempted direct key access `report['pillars']['pillar_02_dataset_a_semantic']['details']['records']` which raised KeyError: 'records'.
corrective_actions_applied: Replaced hardcoded Windows path with dynamic resolution: `WORKSPACE_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent.parent.parent`.
Refactored generate_markdown_report() to be 100% defensive using safe `.get()` lookups and fallback table rendering.
Standardized all pillar records to structured format: {pillar_id, name, status, passed, reason, expected, actual, details}.
Added regression test NairaLLM/tests/test_audit_crash_resilience.py to ensure report generator never crashes under any failure conditions.
